annotations.title: Request or configure a federated binding

description: Without binding, requests (pending approval) that a production app call a federated connection (OIDC): while signs a short token for it, without a secret; federation must be enabled for the organization. With binding: resume: true resumes a suspended binding; approve_production_deploys checks or unchecks the approval of its production deploys.

approve_production_deploys.description: true: its production deploys wait for an approval; false: they do not.

caller.description: A request: the app's service (web), or "task:<name>".

name: set_connection_binding
title: Request or configure a federated binding
